spec_provided_observability.name: Loop current monitoring
spec_provided_observability.purpose: The ECU senses the modulated loop current; out-of-range current indicates a fault.

spec_provided_observability.name: Telegram CRC / parity
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-telegram 2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity lets the ECU detect corrupted telegrams.

spec_provided_observability.name: Time-slot occupancy
spec_provided_observability.purpose: In synchronous mode the ECU observes which time slots returned a telegram and flags missing ones.

spec_provided_observability.name: Sync-pulse presence
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Loss of the ECU sync pulse stops synchronous transmission — a detectable condition.

error_detection_mechanisms: Telegram 2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity detects bit errors.
Missing telegram in an expected time slot (synchronous mode).
Loss of sync pulse in synchronous mode.
